prompt: As the lead network engineer at GammaCorp, you've received a request to ensure that all incoming SSH traffic (port `22`) from the IP address `192.168.1.10` is blocked. Which iptables rule will effectively fulfill this requirement?
explanation: Appending a rule to the INPUT chain matching TCP destination port `22` from source `192.168.1.10` with a DROP target blocks incoming SSH traffic from that host.
